summary: Graduate students who have completed their coursework (수료생), including those expected to complete in August 2026, must register as research students if they fall under one of the categories in the notice, such as using university facilities, submitting a thesis, working as a scholarship student, or participating in BK Plus or research projects. Registration is completed only by paying the KRW 200,000 fee at any NongHyup Bank or Shinhan Bank branch or by transfer to the personal virtual account on the payment bill. The first period runs from 19 August 2026, 09:00 to 2 September 2026, 17:00, and the second and final period runs from 14 September 2026, 09:00 to 28 September 2026, 17:00; late registration is not possible.
applies_to: Graduate students who have completed their coursework (수료생), including those expected to complete in August 2026, who fall under at least one of the following: (a) those who wish to use university facilities (library, laboratories and practice rooms, graduate research rooms, Gwanak Residence Halls, etc.) or to submit a degree thesis in the semester the notice states as 'the first semester of 2026' (this appears in a Fall 2026 notice; please confirm with the department office); (b) those who will work as Lecture and Research Support Scholarship students or Work-Study Scholarship students in Fall 2026 after completion (must register in the first period); (c) those participating in the BK Plus program after completion, or serving as principal investigators or participating researchers on research projects (registration is mandatory). Currently enrolled students are not affected.

dates.what: Earliest payment date for students completing their coursework in August 2026 (first period)
Payment hours during both periods: 24 hours on weekdays, closing at 17:00 on the last day
dates.when: Weekdays, 24 hours; last day closes at 17:00

dates.what: Second and final registration period (fee payment); not available to scholarship students under category (b), who must register in the first period
dates.when: Monday 14 September 2026, 09:00 to 28 September 2026 (shown as Tuesday in the notice), 17:00

conditions: Students who do not register within the registration periods cannot register afterwards.
Currently enrolled students do not need to register.
Students who do not register as research students cannot apply for thesis review, although the doctoral preliminary review is still possible.
Students who will work as Lecture and Research Support Scholarship students or Work-Study Scholarship students in Fall 2026 must register in the first period.
Registration is mandatory for students participating in the BK Plus program and for principal investigators and participating researchers on research projects.
Students completing their coursework in August 2026 can pay only from 1 September 2026.
Payment is the only step; there is no separate application.
Refund requests and other details are in the attachments, which were not read.
steps: Read the attached guidance (2026학년도 2학기 대학원연구생 등록 안내문.hwp, an English version, and the Graduate Research Student Regulations) for refund procedures and other details.

Print the payment bill: log in to mySNU (mysnu.ac.kr) → Academic Affairs/Information [학사/정보] → Registration [등록] → Bill/History Inquiry [고지서/내역조회] → select 'Research Student Fee Bill' [연구생부담금고지서] and print it.

Pay KRW 200,000 within a registration period, either by taking the printed bill to any NongHyup Bank or Shinhan Bank branch, or by transferring the amount to the personal virtual account shown on the bill.
If you need proof of payment, log in to mySNU (mysnu.ac.kr) → Academic Affairs/Information [학사/정보] → Certificates/Confirmations [증명/확인서] → Issue Certificate/Confirmation [증명/확인서 발급].
For questions, contact the department office (Building 301, Room 319); contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Fall 2026 Graduate Research Student Registration

※ Students who do not register within the registration periods cannot register afterwards.

1. Eligible students
Only graduate students who have completed their coursework (수료생) and fall under item a, b or c below should register.
★ Currently enrolled students are not affected! Students expected to complete their coursework in August 2026 who fall under a, b or c must register!
a. Those who have completed a graduate program and wish to use university facilities (library, laboratories and practice rooms, graduate research rooms, Gwanak Residence Halls, etc.) or to submit a degree thesis in the first semester of the 2026 academic year [as written in the notice]
※ Students who do not register as research students cannot apply for thesis review (the doctoral preliminary review is still possible).
b. Those who will work as Lecture and Research Support Scholarship students or Work-Study Scholarship students in Fall 2026 after completion must register in the first registration period.
c. Those participating in the BK Plus program after completion, or principal investigators and participating researchers on research projects: research student registration is mandatory.

2. Registration periods
a. First period: Wednesday 19 August 2026, 09:00 to Wednesday 2 September, 17:00 ★Check the dates!!
※ Students completing their coursework in August 2026 can pay from Tuesday 1 September.
※ Payment is possible 24 hours a day on weekdays (closing at 17:00 on the last day).
b. Second period: Monday 14 September 2026, 09:00 to Tuesday 28 September, 17:00 (final) ★Check the dates!!
※ Payment is possible 24 hours a day on weekdays (closing at 17:00 on the last day).

3. Amount: KRW 200,000 (two hundred thousand won)

4. Place and method of payment (※ There is no separate application procedure apart from payment.)
a. Place: All branches of NongHyup Bank and Shinhan Bank
b. Method:
Method 1) Pay at a designated bank with the computer-printed payment bill.
Method 2) Pay by transfer to the personal virtual account stated on the payment bill.

5. How to print the payment bill
Log in to mySNU (mysnu.ac.kr) → Academic Affairs/Information [학사/정보] → Registration [등록] → Bill/History Inquiry [고지서/내역조회] → select 'Research Student Fee Bill' [연구생부담금고지서] and print.

6. Issuing a payment confirmation
Log in to mySNU (mysnu.ac.kr) → Academic Affairs/Information [학사/정보] → Certificates/Confirmations [증명/확인서] → Issue Certificate/Confirmation [증명/확인서 발급].

7. For refund requests and other details, refer to the attachments.

● Inquiries: Department office (Building 301, Room 319). The contact person and email address are given in the original notice.
